name: commission-calculator
description: Commission payouts and rep statements from your comp plan, to the cent.

interface.longDescription:
Quotaline Commissions calculates sales commission payouts and commission statements for a sales team from its comp plan. Give it the plan terms and the sales, or attach a deals export from your CRM or spreadsheet, and it works out what each rep earned, deal by deal, to the cent.

It handles the plan structures that cause commission disputes: flat rates, tiered commission with marginal (stepped) or retroactive tiers, quota attainment with accelerators and decelerators, commission caps, recoverable and non-recoverable draws against commission with the balance carried forward, split deals (60/40 or across several reps), SPIFFs and bonuses, clawbacks for refunded or cancelled deals inside a clawback window, commission on gross margin, and OTE with target variable pay. When a plan does not say whether tiers are retroactive, both results are shown side by side so you can check the signed plan before payroll.

Typical tasks:
- How much commission do I get on 72k if I earn 5% up to 50k and 8% above?
- How much commission did each rep earn this month? (upload the deals CSV or Excel file; columns such as rep, deal, amount, margin, close date and status are matched automatically)
- Recoverable draw against commission: what is payable now and what carries forward?
- Compare two comp plans at 50% to 200% of quota and see where one overtakes the other.

Each statement lists each deal with the tier and rate applied, the draw recovered, clawbacks and the amount payable now. Download a commission statement PDF (one section per rep, with signature lines) and an Excel workbook with the team summary, each deal line and the tier breakdown. The widget shows rep cards with quota attainment bars and a marginal vs retroactive toggle.

Limitations: it follows the plan terms you enter and does not read comp plan documents. It does not compute payroll taxes, withholding or take-home pay. Up to 5,000 deal rows and 200 reps per run; CSV and .xlsx files only (no PDF or scanned files). Download links expire after about an hour. Results are informational; your signed compensation plan governs.
defaultPrompt: I get 5% up to 50k then 8% above. How much commission on 72k sales?
Quota $100k, 10% to quota then 15% above. Deals $70k and $55k, $3,000 recoverable draw. What's payable?
Compare comp plans on a $100k quota: flat 10% vs 8% up to quota and 14% above. Where does the second pay more?

positive.description: Tiered commission with an unstated tier method (starter prompt 1)
positive.prompt: I get 5% up to 50k then 8% above. How much commission on 72k sales?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_commission with tiers up_to 50000 at 5% and open-ended at 8%, sales_total 72000, and no tier_method. Marginal result: $2,500.00 on the first $50,000 plus $1,760.00 on the $22,000 above, total $4,260.00. Because the question does not say, it also gives the retroactive reading (8% on all $72,000): $5,760.00. The widget shows the tier breakdown, a Marginal/Retroactive toggle, and PDF statement and Excel download buttons.

positive.description: Quota accelerator with a recoverable draw (starter prompt 2)
positive.prompt: Quota $100k, 10% to quota then 15% above. Deals $70k and $55k, $3,000 recoverable draw. What's payable?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_commission with quota 100000, tier_unit quota_percent, tiers 10% up to 100% and 15% above, deals of 70000 and 55000, draw_amount 3000 recoverable. Attainment 125%, credited sales $125,000.00. Marginal: $10,000.00 + $3,750.00 = $13,750.00 earned; after the $3,000.00 draw, payable now $10,750.00. Retroactive reading: $18,750.00 earned, payable now $15,750.00. The widget shows an attainment bar past the quota marker.

positive.description: Compare a flat plan with an accelerated plan (starter prompt 3)
positive.prompt: Compare comp plans on a $100k quota: flat 10% vs 8% up to quota and 14% above. Where does the second pay more?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_comp_plans with plan_a rate 10 and plan_b quota 100000, tier_unit quota_percent, tiers 8% up to 100% and 14% above. Levels 50% to 200% of quota: at $100,000 the flat plan pays $10,000.00 vs $8,000.00; at $150,000 both pay $15,000.00; at $200,000 the second plan pays $22,000.00 vs $20,000.00. Crossover: the second plan pays more above $150,000.00.

positive.description: Split deal across two reps with statements
positive.prompt: Split commission 60/40 on a $50,000 deal between Ana and Ben, plus Ana's own $30,000 deal, at 8%. Statements for each rep.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_commission_statements with rate 8 and two deals: the $50,000 deal with splits Ana 60 and Ben 40, and Ana's $30,000 deal. Ana: credited $60,000.00, commission $4,800.00. Ben: credited $20,000.00, commission $1,600.00. Team total $6,400.00. Returns a PDF with one statement section per rep and an Excel workbook.

positive.prompt: Gross margin plan at 20% of margin: $40,000 deal at 30% margin, $25,000 at 22%, and last month's $10,000 deal was refunded (I was paid $600).
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_commission with commission_base gross_margin, rate 20, the two deals with their margin percentages, and the $10,000 deal with status refunded and commission_paid 600. Credited margin $12,000.00 + $5,500.00 = $17,500.00; commission $2,400.00 + $1,100.00 = $3,500.00; clawback -$600.00; total earned and payable $2,900.00.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: sales commission calculator for flat, tiered (marginal and retroactive), quota accelerator, cap, draw, split, SPIFF, clawback and gross-margin plans; per-rep commission statement PDF and Excel from typed deals or an uploaded CSV/XLSX; comp plan comparison.

pl-PL.subtitle: Prowizje i zestawienia
pl-PL.description:
Kalkulator prowizji od sprzedaży dla prawdziwych planów wynagrodzeń. Podaj warunki planu i sprzedaż albo dołącz eksport transakcji z CRM lub arkusza, a Quotaline Commissions wyliczy, ile zarobił każdy handlowiec, transakcja po transakcji, co do grosza.

Obsługuje progi marginalne (schodkowe) i retroaktywne, realizację planu (quota) z akceleratorami i deceleratorami, limity prowizji, zaliczki (draw) zwrotne i bezzwrotne z przeniesieniem salda, podział transakcji między handlowców, premie SPIFF, zwroty prowizji (clawback) za anulowane lub zwrócone transakcje w określonym oknie, prowizję od marży brutto oraz OTE. Gdy plan nie mówi, czy progi są retroaktywne, pokazuje oba wyniki.

Pobierz zestawienie prowizji w PDF (osobna sekcja dla każdego handlowca) i skoroszyt Excel z podsumowaniem zespołu i każdą transakcją. Porównaj też dwa plany prowizyjne przy różnych poziomach sprzedaży.

Ograniczenia: nie liczy podatków ani wynagrodzenia netto, nie czyta dokumentów planu, do 5000 wierszy i 200 handlowców na raz, tylko pliki CSV i .xlsx. Linki do pobrania wygasają po około godzinie.

de-DE.subtitle: Provisionen und Abrechnungen
de-DE.description:
Ein Provisionsrechner für echte Vergütungspläne im Vertrieb. Geben Sie die Planbedingungen und die Umsätze ein oder hängen Sie einen Deal-Export aus CRM oder Tabelle an, und Quotaline Commissions berechnet für jeden Vertriebsmitarbeiter die Provision pro Abschluss, auf den Cent genau.

Unterstützt Staffelprovisionen mit marginalen (stufenweisen) oder rückwirkenden Stufen, Zielerreichung (Quota) mit Akzeleratoren und Dezeleratoren, Provisionsobergrenzen, rückzahlbare und nicht rückzahlbare Vorschüsse (Draw) mit Saldovortrag, geteilte Abschlüsse, SPIFFs und Boni, Rückforderungen (Clawbacks) bei Stornos oder Erstattungen innerhalb einer Frist, Provision auf den Rohertrag sowie OTE. Wenn der Plan nicht sagt, ob die Stufen rückwirkend gelten, werden beide Ergebnisse gezeigt.

Laden Sie eine Provisionsabrechnung als PDF (ein Abschnitt pro Mitarbeiter) und eine Excel-Arbeitsmappe mit Teamübersicht und allen Abschlüssen herunter. Vergleichen Sie außerdem zwei Provisionspläne bei verschiedenen Umsatzniveaus.

Grenzen: keine Steuer- oder Nettolohnberechnung, liest keine Plandokumente, bis zu 5.000 Zeilen und 200 Mitarbeiter pro Lauf, nur CSV- und .xlsx-Dateien. Download-Links laufen nach etwa einer Stunde ab.

es-ES.subtitle: Comisiones y liquidaciones
es-ES.description:
Una calculadora de comisiones de ventas para planes de compensación reales. Indica las condiciones del plan y las ventas, o adjunta una exportación de operaciones del CRM o de una hoja de cálculo, y Quotaline Commissions calcula lo que ganó cada comercial, operación por operación, al céntimo.

Admite tramos marginales (escalonados) o retroactivos, cumplimiento de cuota con aceleradores y deceleradores, topes de comisión, anticipos (draw) recuperables y no recuperables con saldo arrastrado, operaciones compartidas, SPIFF y bonos, recuperación de comisiones (clawback) por devoluciones o cancelaciones dentro de un plazo, comisión sobre margen bruto y OTE. Si el plan no aclara si los tramos son retroactivos, muestra ambos resultados.

Descarga una liquidación de comisiones en PDF (una sección por comercial) y un libro de Excel con el resumen del equipo y cada operación. También puedes comparar dos planes de comisiones en distintos niveles de ventas.

Limitaciones: no calcula impuestos ni salario neto, no lee documentos del plan, hasta 5.000 filas y 200 comerciales por ejecución, solo archivos CSV y .xlsx. Los enlaces de descarga caducan en aproximadamente una hora.

fr-FR.subtitle: Commissions et relevés
fr-FR.description:
Un calculateur de commissions commerciales pour de vrais plans de rémunération. Indiquez les conditions du plan et les ventes, ou joignez un export des affaires depuis votre CRM ou un tableur, et Quotaline Commissions calcule ce que chaque commercial a gagné, affaire par affaire, au centime près.

Il gère les paliers marginaux (progressifs) ou rétroactifs, l'atteinte de quota avec accélérateurs et décélérateurs, les plafonds, les avances sur commission (draw) récupérables ou non avec report du solde, les affaires partagées, les SPIFF et primes, les reprises de commission (clawback) en cas de remboursement ou d'annulation dans un délai, la commission sur marge brute et l'OTE. Si le plan ne précise pas si les paliers sont rétroactifs, les deux résultats sont affichés.

Téléchargez un relevé de commissions en PDF (une section par commercial) et un classeur Excel avec la synthèse de l'équipe et chaque affaire. Comparez aussi deux plans de commissions à plusieurs niveaux de ventes.

Limites : ne calcule ni impôts ni salaire net, ne lit pas les documents du plan, jusqu'à 5 000 lignes et 200 commerciaux par calcul, fichiers CSV et .xlsx uniquement. Les liens de téléchargement expirent après environ une heure.

ja-JP.subtitle: 営業コミッション計算と明細
ja-JP.description:
実際の報酬プランに対応した営業コミッション計算ツールです。プラン条件と売上を入力するか、CRMやスプレッドシートから出力した案件一覧を添付すると、Quotaline Commissionsが担当者ごとの獲得コミッションを案件単位で1セント単位まで計算します。

限界的（段階的）ティアと遡及ティア、ノルマ達成率に応じたアクセラレーターとディセラレーター、上限額、返済型・非返済型のドロー（前払い）と残高の繰越、案件の分割、SPIFFやボーナス、期間内の返金・解約によるクローバック、粗利ベースのコミッション、OTEに対応します。プランにティアが遡及型かどうかの記載がない場合は、両方の結果を表示します。

担当者ごとのセクションを含むコミッション明細PDFと、チーム集計と全案件を含むExcelブックをダウンロードできます。2つの報酬プランを複数の売上水準で比較することもできます。

制限事項：税金や手取り額は計算しません。プラン文書は読み取りません。1回あたり最大5,000行・200人、CSVと.xlsxのみ対応。ダウンロードリンクは約1時間で失効します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Comissões e extratos
pt-BR.description:
Uma calculadora de comissão de vendas para planos de remuneração reais. Informe as regras do plano e as vendas, ou anexe uma exportação de negócios do CRM ou da planilha, e o Quotaline Commissions calcula quanto cada vendedor ganhou, negócio a negócio, até o centavo.

Suporta faixas marginais (escalonadas) ou retroativas, atingimento de cota com aceleradores e desaceleradores, teto de comissão, adiantamentos (draw) recuperáveis e não recuperáveis com saldo transportado, negócios divididos, SPIFFs e bônus, estorno de comissão (clawback) por reembolso ou cancelamento dentro de um prazo, comissão sobre margem bruta e OTE. Quando o plano não diz se as faixas são retroativas, os dois resultados são mostrados.

Baixe um extrato de comissões em PDF (uma seção por vendedor) e uma pasta de trabalho do Excel com o resumo da equipe e cada negócio. Compare também dois planos de comissão em vários níveis de vendas.

Limitações: não calcula impostos nem salário líquido, não lê documentos do plano, até 5.000 linhas e 200 vendedores por execução, apenas arquivos CSV e .xlsx. Os links de download expiram em cerca de uma hora.
